Titles.eng: Eiga Oshiri Tantei Saraba Itoshiki Aibō (Oshiri) yo
Titles.jpn: 映画おしりたんてい さらば愛しき相棒(おしり)よ

Summaries.eng: The story depicts how Oshiri Tantei falls into a desperate crisis after being caught up in a huge conspiracy due to the appearance of his former partner.
Summaries.jpn: かつての相棒の登場によって巨大な陰謀に巻き込まれ、おしりたんていが絶体絶命の危機に陥る姿を描く。
